column4: this runner is x86_64 with no binfmt/QEMU, so the linux/arm64 image cannot be executed and tests/csharp needPlatform skips the leg (an "exec format error" probe, any other failure is fatal); the arm64 row of the lock is verified by the csharp-tier2-arm64 job on a native arm64 runner, which declares csharp-arm64 so that leg fails instead of skipping there (cleat#4080, C# PR 7)
